$comment: P69 (lane lm, D-C-STDIO-H-LACKS-THIRTEEN-ISO-FUNCTIONS): <stdio.h>'s C 7.23 functions a program could not name before P69 — tmpfile, tmpnam, setbuf, fgetpos, fsetpos, the scanf family (scanf, fscanf, vscanf, vfscanf, vsscanf) and the va_list printf family (vprintf, vsprintf, vsnprintf) — with fpos_t and BUFSIZ/FOPEN_MAX/L_tmpnam/TMP_MAX. A tmpfile is round-tripped through fgetpos/fsetpos and read back with fscanf and vfscanf; text is formatted through vsnprintf (bounded and truncating), vsprintf and vprintf and read back through vsscanf and sscanf; setbuf hands the stream a BUFSIZ buffer; tmpnam fills an L_tmpnam array. On pe and Mach-O every printf and scanf entry point is DSS's C23 entry point, runtime/platform/src/stdio.c (over the UCRT's __stdio_common_v* cores on pe, which export none of the family, and over libSystem's own functions on Mach-O); on ELF the scanf family binds glibc's C23 entry points (__isoc23_<name> @GLIBC_2.38) and the printf family glibc's own. ✔MEASURED, the same stdout and exit 42 from gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 on glibc 2.39, Apple clang 21 on both arches and MSVC 19.51 on the UCRT (probe-reference-cc runs 20260930-223022-28dd5d84, 20260930-222954-f4d022ae, 20260930-223316-9b692574). The minimums line prints C's own floors (BUFSIZ >= 256, FOPEN_MAX >= 8, TMP_MAX >= 25) and the tmpnam contract (the name fits L_tmpnam) — each library's own values are pinned per pair by tests/ffi/test_stdio_h_iso_surface. ⚠ A mingw-w64 gcc that links msvcrt.dll prints tmpnam=0: msvcrt's L_tmpnam is 14 and its tmpnam writes a full temp-directory path past it (measured, same runs) — the UCRT's L_tmpnam is 260.
